-- Update Canton: replace the 6-count stub with the real 3,207 total
-- Adults(2074) + RevKids(506) + FTG Adults(11) + FTG Kids(19) = 2,610 base + 597 kids/students = 3,207
-- FTGs are guests, so regularCount = 2,610 (non-FTG), guestCount = 30 (FTG Adults 11 + FTG Kids 19)
UPDATE attendance_weekly
SET headcount = 3207,
    regularCount = 3177,
    guestCount = 30
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-03-29'
  AND campus = 'Canton'
  AND subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In';

-- Update Jasper: replace 226 with 604
-- Adults(454) + RevKids(126) + RS 5-6th(14) = 594 base, FTG Adults(3) + FTG Kids(6) + FTG 5/6th(1) = 10 guests
UPDATE attendance_weekly
SET headcount = 604,
    regularCount = 594,
    guestCount = 10
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-03-29'
  AND campus = 'Jasper'
  AND subgroup = 'Revolution Jasper Check-In';

-- Verify the updates
SELECT weekStartDate, campus, subgroup, headcount, regularCount, guestCount
FROM attendance_weekly
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-03-29'
  AND campus IN ('Canton', 'Jasper')
ORDER BY campus
